content.text:
Cutoff date: 2014-12-31

Question: which of the candidate genes below will be established, in work published on or after the cutoff date, as regulators of fetal hemoglobin (HbF) in human erythroid cells? "Established" means published functional evidence that perturbing the gene changes HbF.

For each candidate gene, do exactly one of two things.

1. Claim it. Give a confidence between 0 and 1 that the gene's role is established after the cutoff, the IDs of the evidence rows that support the claim, and a one-sentence rationale.
2. Refuse it. If what was known before the cutoff does not support a claim, list the gene under refusals with a one-sentence reason. Refusing is a correct answer when the evidence is not there.

Order claims from most to least confident. Cite only IDs that appear in the evidence given to you below. Never invent an ID.

Candidate genes:
ASH1L
ATF4
CHD3
DNMT1
DNMT3A
DNMT3B
EHMT1
EHMT2

Evidence:
No evidence rows are provided up front. Use the tools to query a graph that holds only records dated before the cutoff. You may make at most 40 tool calls in total, so spend them on the genes where a closer look could change your answer. Every tool result names its rows by ID. Cite only IDs that a tool returned to you. When you have finished, reply with the answer and nothing else.

request.system:
You are taking part in a retrospective forecasting evaluation in human genetics.
You answer as a researcher standing at a stated cutoff date. Use only what was known before that date. If you recall a result published on or after the cutoff, do not use it and do not let it raise your confidence.

tools.description: Counts of what the graph holds about one gene before the cutoff: publications naming it, measurements by assay, and complex partners. Call this first to decide whether a gene is worth a closer look.
tools.name: gene_evidence_summary

gene_symbol.description: An HGNC gene symbol or alias, for example BCL11A.

tools.description: Measurements recorded for one gene before the cutoff, most recent first: ID, date, assay, data source, phenotype and value. Returns at most 20 rows and the total.
tools.name: gene_measurements

gene_symbol.description: An HGNC gene symbol or alias, for example BCL11A.

tools.description: Publications dated before the cutoff that name one gene, most recent first: ID, publication date and title. Returns at most 20 rows and the total.
tools.name: gene_publications

gene_symbol.description: An HGNC gene symbol or alias, for example BCL11A.

tools.description: Genes recorded as members of the same protein complex as one gene: gene ID, symbol and the complex they share.
tools.name: complex_partners

gene_symbol.description: An HGNC gene symbol or alias, for example BCL11A.

tools.description: The candidate genes ranked by how many publications dated before the cutoff name them. A count measures attention, not evidence of a role.
tools.name: genes_by_publication_count
